correctness.rationale: For each n=2..7 the binary source/output incidence matrix is independently rebuilt. The package contains feasible word sets of sizes 3,4,7,12,19,33 and complete exhaustive integer-decision branch trees with nonnegative exact scaled-rational dual inequalities at each viable leaf. For n=7 the tree has 103 nodes/52 leaves; every upper bound is strictly below the next integer. Standard-library exact checker replay succeeded. This proves only the stated finite domain. The package also checks a 25-node dual-branch proof of the known unique-decoding maximum 16 at n=7, so the non-decomposability conclusion is self-contained.

value.rationale: The length-7 optimum 33 exceeds the 32 codewords available from any union of two binary unique single-deletion correcting codes, as each has size at most 16 (No 2019). This demonstrates non-decomposable list-decoding gain at the first such length in the complete n=2..7 profile; the exact finite optimum is a natural benchmark with portable rational proofs. The known unique-decoding size-16 benchmark is independently certified by a supporting 25-node proof tree.
